newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP says Whyalla steel works safe.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP says Whyalla steel works safe.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Wednesday the closure of its steelworks at Whyalla, South Australia, was not on the agenda but a review of operations at Newcastle, New South Wales had not yet reached any conclusion.

Asked if he could give any guarantee that closure was not on the agenda for Newcastle, BHP Steel chief executive Ron McNeilly told a news conference a review of operations "had not reached any conclusion whatsoever".
"The exercise is underway to determine whether we make steel in Newcastle by electric furnace or whether we feed the mills at Whyalla from other centres," McNeilly said.
